description: Matte black, softly faceted, handing back no light at all. In a full pouch you find this one by touch, not by eye.
lore: Stones are sorted on a dark cloth by lamplight, and every one says something on the way down — a coin of light, a stripe. This one lands and there is only cloth where it landed. Old hands still count the row twice before tying the bag. The fix is [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]]'s: any pouch that leaves her bench with one of these inside has a bright thread sewn to it, no charge, no comment. You check the thread.

Set in a blade it is the not-being-seen, finished and portable. Fights end, and the ending does not particularly include you: the shape goes down looking at somebody else. Off a creature that spent its whole loud life [[monsters/diablo|charging head-first]], that is the stone's one correction — the charge was the noise. The bottom fact was never being looked at.

Sigrun also keeps one loose in her apron, unset. A smithy is a place where people stand about and watch your hands, and on the days when the work on the bench is a cracking, she would rather the watching slid off.
